model.status: provisional: 0.2.0 on the test site only; 0.1.0 (params.json) is the default and the rollback
model.independence: Uses only box scores, minutes, pace and the game engine. Exchange prices are never an input; they are compared afterwards.
model.injuries: No NBA injury feed is used by this version. A rotation player who missed his team's last two games is treated as out; anyone else is assumed available.

notes: Each game day is projected with games before that day only; graded on players who played.
Scored on the same rows as 0.1.0: thresholds where the player's own recent hit rate is 5-95%, players averaging 18+ minutes recently (not filtered on either model's output).
Per-market calibration fit on 2020-21 and 2021-22 and applied before scoring.

Changes from 0.1.0: per-minute rates shrink toward players in the same role (position x minutes band); missing team minutes go to players with room below their own recent high; the usage boost from an absent teammate fades as the absence ages and is half as strong; wider game-to-game minutes noise.
There is no NBA injury feed: a rotation player who missed his team's last two games is treated as out.
No historical prop prices: ROI and closing-line value need stored market snapshots.
